# Pricing Smoke Test (Lightweight)

## Goal
Estimate willingness-to-pay range without over-building.

## Preconditions
- Problem clarity (you can describe the outcome in one sentence)
- Defined target segment (not “everyone”)

## Option A: Price Ladder (Interview Add-on)
Ask after the problem is understood.

1) “At $X/month, would this be a great deal / fair / too expensive?”
2) “At $Y/month, would you still consider it?”
3) “At $Z/month, is it a definite no?”

Record:
- Role of respondent (buyer vs user)
- Procurement constraints (approval thresholds)

## Option B: Landing Page + Price Anchor
- Create a one-page pitch (problem → promise → proof → CTA)
- Test 2–3 price points (or tiers) with separate variants
- CTA should reflect intent:
  - “Request access” / “Book a demo” (B2B)
  - “Pre-order” / “Join waitlist” (B2C)

Success signals:
- CTR to CTA
- Completed CTA rate
- Qualified follow-up acceptance rate

## Decision Rule
- If you can’t get *any* qualified users to accept a price conversation, revisit the segment/problem.
- If users accept price but won’t commit time/money, improve proof (pilot, demo, outcome).
